name: Komagawa Mizuha
source:
A no-nonsense doctor who comes from a family with a long history of distinguished medical professionals.

She runs Hoori's clinic and has the trust
of all the townsfolk.

[From [url=http://senren.nekonyansoft.com/chara.html]NekoNyan[/url]]
